summary.text: Darian Counts is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which Counts faces incumbent Republican James DeSana.
Counts has a career in sales and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Darian Counts earned a high school diploma from Woodhaven High School, and Ballotpedia lists the candidate's career experience as working in sales.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Counts said the candidate is a lifelong resident of Southeastern Michigan, a former Republican who now identifies as a progressive, and has spent the last decade selling Ford vehicles.
Counts listed national health care, national immigration reform, election integrity policy, public education including public college, and property tax reform as policy areas of interest.
